top_paper.title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
top_paper.summary: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public. We present Open Vision Banana (OVB), a fully open and reproducible recipe for converting pretrained generators into unified multi-task perception systems. papers.title: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
papers.summary: JVT, a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer, enables pixel-space video diffusion without pretrained autoencoders or U-Net skip connections, achieving competitive quality and supporting joint camera-conditioned RGB-disparity generation.

papers.title: Aligning AI Teams
papers.summary: Alignment training on individual LLM agents often fails to transfer to multi-agent teams, but designating a safety lead and having a coordinator publish safety specifications can restore single-agent alignment.

papers.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
papers.summary: Gamer is a generalist agent framework that integrates perception, memory, and multi-step reasoning, trained through continued pre-training, sparse-thinking instruction tuning, and multi-turn reinforcement learning to interact efficiently in 2D and 3D environments.

papers.title: CANTraj: Recovering Vehicle Trajectories from CAN Signals in Naturalistic Driving
papers.summary: Open driving releases and usage-based insurance programs often claim to prevent privacy breaches by omitting GPS records when sharing or collecting vehicle data. However, removing GPS coordinates from driving logs does not erase the location information carried by vehicle signals. papers.title: MEM-SQL: Memory-Empowered Text-to-SQL
papers.summary: A history-aware benchmark and memory-powered method improve Text-to-SQL accuracy and reduce cost by reusing verified SQL components and consulting schemas on demand.

papers.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
papers.summary: Large language models used for peer review draw about half or more of their identified weaknesses from paper appendices, whereas human reviewers draw only 8.4% and focus on presentation and core ideas.

papers.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
papers.summary: Agentic robotics, centered on an Embodied System 2 formed by a foundation model and embodied harness, requires a shared evaluation framework and research roadmap to achieve reliable physical autonomy.

papers.title: Rethinking in Spikes: Mitigating Hallucinations in MDLMs with Step-Aware Decoding
papers.summary: StepRefine, a plug-and-play decoding strategy, mitigates hallucinations in multimodal diffusion language models by switching between discrete denoising and latent refinement based on entropy spikes and distributional stability.

papers.title: GH-AWTrace: A Large-Scale Dataset of GitHub Agentic Workflow Execution Logs
papers.summary: Agentic workflows enable AI agents to perform recurring repository tasks on schedules or in response to repository events. Existing studies examine workflow definitions and outputs, but provide limited evidence of what happens during execution. We present GH-AWTrace, a dataset linking 25,014 verified GitHub Agentic Workflows across 5,051 repositories to 4,112,526 run records and 562,877 nonempty execution log archives. The dataset preserves execution evidence subject to GitHub's log-retention limits and links it to repository metadata and generated workflow configurations. Illustrative cases s

papers.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
papers.summary: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. papers.title: HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation
papers.summary: Learning whole-body mobile manipulation requires demonstrations that coordinate bimanual actions with locomotion across extended workspaces. However, existing interfaces trade off direct robot control, perception and action alignment, and natural operator mobility, making such demonstrations difficult to collect. We introduce HALO, a human-aligned data collection system for whole-body mobile manipulation. papers.title: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers
papers.summary: A looped Transformer that separately controls input strength, total update weight, and per-update allocation achieves lower validation loss and higher downstream accuracy than standard and looped residual baselines while using fewer parameters.

papers.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
papers.summary: MixUA distills lessons from independent user-agent trajectories and assigns them to appropriate scopes to balance cross-user and cross-agent learning with privacy, evaluated by CrossLearnBench.

papers.title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
papers.summary: EgoX is an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that pretrains a modular Transformer with embodiment dreaming on heterogeneous human, robot, and simulated demonstrations, then fine-tunes it to improve manipulation task progress, especially under out-of-distribution conditions.

papers.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
papers.summary: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. papers.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
papers.summary: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. papers.title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
papers.summary: Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate computational fluid dynamics, yet progress is limited by the lack of benchmarks capturing realistic, time-dependent turbulent flows. We introduce TurtLES, a 14 TB dataset of 3D turbulent cylinder wakes in the shear-layer transition regime, computed via high-fidelity implicit large-eddy simulations. The dataset contains 400 trajectories of 400 time steps each, with 3-11 million points per frame, spanning variations in geometry, Reynolds number, and angle of attack. papers.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
papers.summary: A hybrid decision model routes between implicit single-forward-pass answering and full autoregressive reasoning via a self-routing block trained with calibrated decision policy optimization, reducing token and latency costs while preserving accuracy.

papers.title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
papers.summary: A benchmark of news articles and queries shows that current large language models cannot reliably help users navigate diverse multilingual narratives, leaving gaps in exposure to competing accounts and risking echo chambers and information disparities.

papers.title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
papers.summary: A vision-language model trained on nearly one million clinical neuroimaging studies interprets complete examinations, discusses findings in natural language, and outperforms existing general and medical models in diagnosis, localization, reporting, and progression assessment.

papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
papers.summary: Controlled experiments show that multimodal language models do not need a pretrained vision encoder, but benefit from dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and integrated early rather than before fusion.

papers.title: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Language-model agents trained with reinforcement learning can improve by learning to create and curate experience artifacts that help future rollouts, not just by optimizing actions from scalar rewards.

papers.title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
papers.summary: A simplified evaluation harness that keeps full episode history and stops motions early substantially improves robot-use agent scores on RoboDojo, with scene geometry providing the largest additional benefit.

papers.title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: A survey analyzes why self-improvement mechanisms for multimodal agents transfer unevenly across reasoning, generation, navigation, and manipulation scenarios, framing them as trade-offs over scarce factors and task-structural resources.

papers.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Exposing benchmark success criteria to self-improving embodied coding agents can raise measured success under those criteria without improving instructed-task completion, and the advantage weakens under slight criteria changes and transfers poorly across tasks, while instruction-faithful criteria better reflect instructed-task performance.

papers.title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
papers.summary: A dynamic stress-testing framework shows that search agents often answer confidently despite unreliable retrieved evidence and may rely on memorized knowledge when documents are factually wrong.

papers.title: Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
papers.summary: A hybrid adversarial training approach combining cross-entropy and KL divergence with geometry-aware perturbations on the confidence manifold improves robustness and transferability by targeting confidence structure deformation.

papers.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: A novel multimodal memory framework enhances long-term interaction by combining relational graph expansion of semantic seeds with query-adaptive composition of heterogeneous evidence forms.

papers.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
papers.summary: By baking global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, Test-Time Baking (TTB) enhances the fidelity of novel-view decoding in Large View Synthesis Models while maintaining the efficiency of Test-Time Training.
